summary: HireVue's video interview software scored job candidates using their facial expressions, speech and word choice. After criticism and a privacy complaint, the company dropped the facial analysis feature in 2021.
technical_summary: A video-interview assessment system analyzed candidates' facial movements, intonation and language with machine learning to assign trait and employability scores. Critics said the inferences were scientifically unfounded, opaque and potentially biased against some speakers; the facial analysis component was withdrawn.

summary: A French digital health company tested GPT-3 for medical documentation, diagnosis support and treatment advice. It found the model too inconsistent and lacking medical expertise to be safe for healthcare use.
technical_summary: Researchers evaluated a general-purpose large language model on healthcare tasks and found inconsistent outputs and no real medical expertise, making it risky for clinical use. This was a capability evaluation, not a harm event; the only available report is an index page.
notes: Only report is an AIID index page about downgraded incidents; coded from the AIID description. Downgraded to an issue.

summary: Scammers used AI-generated faces for fake lawyer profiles at a made-up Boston law firm. They sent a bogus copyright notice to a website owner, part of a scheme that included extorting backlinks from bloggers.
technical_summary: Generative image models produced realistic but non-existent headshots for staff profiles on a fake law firm website. The synthetic identities lent credibility to fraudulent DMCA takedown emails used to pressure site owners.

summary: Residents of a California hillside town said the Waze navigation app sent heavy weekend beach traffic through their neighborhoods, clogging their only escape route in case of a wildfire or emergency.
technical_summary: A crowd-sourced routing algorithm diverted highway traffic onto residential backroads to minimize driver travel time. Residents and fire officials said the resulting congestion could block evacuation and emergency response, an externality the optimization did not account for.

notes: Claims come from a local advocacy group; risk is potential, not a realized wildfire harm. Routing treated as an optimization algorithm.

summary: A Google self-driving test car pulled out into the path of a city bus in Mountain View, California, at very low speed. No one was injured, and Google accepted partial responsibility.
technical_summary: An autonomous test vehicle, avoiding sandbags, assumed an approaching bus would yield and re-entered the lane. The system and its safety driver both misjudged the bus's behaviour, causing a roughly 2 mph collision. Google added tests and adjusted its software.

summary: Twitter's own researchers found its algorithmic Home timeline amplified tweets from right-leaning politicians and news outlets more than left-leaning ones in six of seven countries studied. Twitter said the cause was unclear.
technical_summary: A personalization and ranking algorithm for the Home timeline was compared with a reverse-chronological control group. Amplification of elected officials' tweets and news sources favored the political right in most countries studied, for reasons the platform could not explain.

summary: A foundation-funded teacher evaluation program used data and an algorithm to rate teachers. An independent review found it did not improve student results, and a critic argued it unfairly damaged teachers' careers.
technical_summary: The initiative combined test-score value-added models, principal observations and surveys to score teacher performance and drive hiring, firing and rewards. Value-added models were noisy and opaque, other measures were biased, and student achievement goals were not met.

summary: ChatGPT briefly produced gibberish, mixed languages and off-topic rants for many users. OpenAI said a bug had been introduced in how the model processes language and then fixed it.
technical_summary: An optimization to the user experience introduced a bug in the step where the model selects numbers mapping to tokens, causing incoherent text generation. OpenAI identified the fault, rolled out a fix within about a day and restored normal service.

summary: A NewsGuard investigation found TikTok's For You feed steered new accounts toward false and misleading videos about the war in Ukraine within about 40 minutes, often without warnings or source information.
